summary.intent: Land the fix for the PR 423 review finding (exclude-pattern directory semantics) and plan follow-up work from the seam investigation so the first Chakra component answer from the checker is correct and fast enough.
summary.outcome: The PR 423 fix landed as 059cb9a6 with three new tests and the PR body updated. Five follow-up trail tasks (#328-#333) were created, and a worker was started on the wait-and-join branch (feat/wait-and-join) covering #329 and #330.

repo: Exclude matching must go through one enforcement point: excluded(relative, kind: EntryKind, ..) in crates/core/src/pipeline/discover.rs, with a required File/Dir enum and no default. It tests every path prefix as a directory, so an excluded parent takes its whole subtree and a `!` cannot re-include inside it (gitignore semantics).
discover_files, discover_dirs and is_source_file must agree on every exclude list. A nine-list consistency test enforces this, and the watcher only calls discover_dirs and discover_files.

is_source_file (callers revision.rs ~513 and watch/lazy.rs ~280) ignores .gitignore and hidden-file handling that the walkers apply, so a gitignored changed path is still extracted by update_file. Tracked as trail #328.

Resolution configs should be dropped only when their parent directory is excluded, not by user excludes like `*`. Directories named like source files (X.tsx) must not be returned as files, and .stories/.test/.spec name rules apply to files only.

Chakra performance: the structural path has props for only 140 of 938 components, so ChakraButton answers at 160 ms with 0 props under the default 150 ms semanticWaitMs. The checker returns 1,138 props in about 0.4-0.8 s, and cold conversion costs 346-372 ms.
The checker queue is FIFO. A request for a component already in flight queues behind the first instead of joining it, so a story asked during its own prefetch took 983-3,476 ms.

538 Chakra condition maps share one constraint. A scratch memo keyed by (constraint, map symbol) cut requests from 4,590 to 4,054 and was byte-identical on 97 components, but only with the guard (more than 40 props, none project-declared, no signatures). The unguarded version changed MuiTextField's output.
Storybook 11 starts the docgen worker on the first extract, so nothing in the worker can run earlier. The addon's warmUp resolves 8 components spread over all keys, not the ones the stories use.
tsrs has no upstream request for this, and a tsrs-only request would split the protocol from the Go checker.

code.finding: excluded() is now the single enforcement point for exclude semantics, taking an EntryKind (File/Dir). Call sites: visit and discover_dirs pass the real kind, and is_source_file uses File and returns false for directories.

Target of trails #329 and #330: wait longer for the checker on an empty structural answer, and keep one pending request per (key, file hash) so later callers join it.
Needs two queues with interactive requests ahead of background ones (trail #330).

workflow: Write tests before the source change and confirm they fail on base. The worker re-ran the watch test on base via git checkout of the file instead of stashing.

Delegate independent work to subagents with explicit verification commands (just lint doc-check machete typos, just semver, cargo check, nextest, test-napi, test-ts). Treat subagent reports as reports rather than user approval.
Count requests with a recording runner instead of wall-clock when the machine is under load (load 20-48 made times upper bounds).
Sequence work that touches the same file: trail #331 waits for PR 426 to merge because it edits convert.rs, and S7a2/S7b wait for the same reason.
Record out-of-scope findings as trail tasks with intent, change and gate sections instead of expanding the PR.

friction: The shared machine was at load 20-48, so timings were only upper bounds.
The worker did not wait for CI after pushing, so CI status is unverified.
TSRS_BIN was not set in the worker's shell, though nothing it ran used it.
Oracle and corpus runs were not run, as instructed.
Chakra cold first-answer cost cannot be brought under 150 ms by any single lever.
open_items: Trail #328: unify is_source_file with the walkers' .gitignore and hidden-file handling, with a consistency test.
Trail #329 (high): wait up to about 2 s for the checker when the structural answer is empty. This is the S8 prerequisite.
Trail #330: join in-flight checker requests and put the open story first. Both #329 and #330 are in progress on feat/wait-and-join.
Trail #331: condition-map memo, then per-prop documentation cache. Blocked on PR 426 (S7a) merging.
Trail #332: spike for startup prefetch through Storybook's docgen service. Needs the in-flight join first.
Trail #333: reword the ADR 0026 S4/S6 budgets. Needs the owner's decision: keep 150 ms for prefetched or cached stories and record the cold first answer as measured rather than gated.
Open PRs and workers: #423 (updated, CI not confirmed), #425 (Object.assign fix worker still running), #426 (S7a draft), #396.
